Items.FirstPartyIndependentStudentPrompt: With 75 trees/acre each yields20 bushels. For each extra tree yield per tree drops3 bushels. Under the algebraic rule, determine integer tree count maximizing total bushels with nonnegative per-tree yield.
Items.TeacherExactMathematicsAndScoring: Set n=75+x, per-tree yield20−3x; total Y=(75+x)(20−3x)=1500−205x−3x². Continuous optimum x=−205/6≈−34.17, so n≈40.83; best integer n=41, total 41×122=5002 bushels. However original wording only specifies added trees; extrapolating yield to fewer trees requires explicit assumption.
SourceCognitiveActions: state exact mathematics with domain if applicable
